title: Tax rules unavailable on new billing pods
summary: Tax quote requests are failing on newly started billing pods while existing traffic remains mostly healthy.
precursor: A canary release added tax jurisdiction support and began replacing the stable billing replica set.
impact: Some checkout sessions cannot calculate a final total, increasing abandoned checkouts and support contacts.

title: Catalog workers reject the new rollout settings
summary: Catalog indexing throughput drops sharply after the rollout, with repeated restarts among the replacement workers.
precursor: A deployment promoted an updated indexer image and configuration bundle to the first production shard.
impact: New and changed products take hours to appear in search, causing stale inventory visibility for shoppers.

title: Recommendation service cannot reach its feature store
summary: Recommendation requests intermittently fall back to generic results immediately after a service update.
precursor: A configuration rollout moved the recommendation deployment into a revised service-discovery layout.
impact: Personalized product placement disappears for a portion of sessions, reducing engagement on category pages.

title: Payment authorization requests exceed their latency budget
summary: Authorization attempts are timing out more often during peak traffic following the payment gateway rollout.
precursor: A staged release changed the payment integration profile while a large traffic cohort was being shifted to the new pods.
impact: Customers see delayed or uncertain payment outcomes, and order confirmation rates fall during busy periods.

title: Session refresh calls fail after identity policy update
summary: Users are unexpectedly signed out across several applications shortly after the identity gateway rollout.
precursor: An identity policy package was rolled out alongside a gateway image refresh during a routine credential rotation window.
impact: Active sessions require reauthentication, increasing login traffic and interrupting customer workflows.
